recipe.build:
sed -ri '/org.gradle.toolchains.foojay-resolver-convention/d' settings.gradle.kts
sed -ri 's/compileSdk = 37/compileSdk { version = release(37) { minorApiLevel = 0 } }/' app/build.gradle.kts
mkdir -p ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk
unzip -q "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_PATH}" -d ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk
mv ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/android-ndk-r${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION:0:2}? ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION}
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION}
echo "ndk.dir=${ANDROID_NDK}" >> local.properties
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleCommunityRelease -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs="-Xmx4g -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError"
find . -name '*.apk'
mkdir reproducible-apk-tools
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_REPRO_APK_PATH}" --strip-components=1 -C reproducible-apk-tools/
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-size 16 --pad-like-apksigner --replace app/build/outputs/apk/community/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
